review.imagery: Root reviewed all 32 original brochure spreads and all 26 cached current website candidates. Twenty-two selected original architectural, private residential concept and shared-amenity renders retain their published Tara Park context. Four site icons and generic lifestyle photography were excluded. Current gallery and master-site imagery do not establish the selected contracted phase, building or unit. The original phase-one brochure text refers to two towers while the researched current overview/FAQ conflict remains explicit.
review.floorPlans: Root viewed all seven delivered complete source sheets and read all five GSA panels, room tables, bedroom headers and level keys. One-bedroom range is 81.5–91.3 m². Both two-bedroom samples print 121.2–169 m² and both three-bedroom samples 146.8–190.6 m². These are family ranges, with selected unit area unverified. Middle/corner labels follow each original header. Preliminary source notices, including the template villa wording on apartment sheets, remain intact. Current web size ranges and contracted phase/revision remain explicitly unresolved. Full original PDFs and physical pages remain preserved.
review.location: Root read the complete current regional JPEG, original brochure regional page 7 and full site/amenity page 12. Six destination figures agree across the two regional sources. Concentric minute rings do not become invented destination journeys. Current HTML has a stale Bashayer title on an image whose actual Tara/Reem geography and Tara source URL were visually confirmed. The generic Hudayriyat sales-centre coordinates were excluded. No exact tower entrance, live route or kilometre journey was inferred. Proposed Disney resort scope was corroborated with the primary announcement retained for this chapter.
review.provenance: Normal-GET receipts retain current official HTML, every selected image and regional map, two original broker-hosted PDFs, dates, original bytes and SHA256. Whole drawing spreads retain their original notices and source-page attribution. The PDF renderer emitted a font-weight warning for the regional sheet, whose complete labels and layout were visually verified after rendering. All protected identities and prior commercial research remain preserved.

unavailable: Selected-unit area, contracted building/phase/level and revision, confirmed final finishes, operational bridge and proposed destination access, surveyed tower entrances, current live routes and kilometre journeys remain unverified.
